childQuestions.transcript:
motivate: done or happening for a particular reason

pressure: the act of trying to persuade or to force somebody to do something

interrupt: to say or do something that makes somebody stop what they are saying or doing

dismiss: to decide that somebody/something is not important and not worth thinking or talking about

Based on the meaning of words.

=> Choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
motivate: thúc đẩy, làm động lực

pressure: áp lực

interrupt: ngắt

dismiss: bác bỏ

=> C có nghĩa phù hợp nhất

options: (A) A realtor will be showing people around the building during this time.
(B) The maintenance check lasted through the weekend.
(C) We are sorry that we were unable to complete the inspection.
(D) We intend to restore electricity immediately following the inspection.
correctOptions: (D) We intend to restore electricity immediately following the inspection.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on the previous sentence " We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause."

=> Choose D
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Dựa vào các câu trước chỗ trống "During this time, the power supply will be interrupted. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause." (Trong thời gian này, điện sẽ bị cắt. Chúng tôi xin lỗi vì sự bất tiện này.)

=> Nói về việc kiểm tra bảo trì và ngắt điện.

=> Đáp án D phù hợp nhất (Chúng tôi dự định cấp lại điện ngay sau khi bảo trì xong.)

childQuestions.transcript:
"In this case" when referring to the situation if it happened or did happen, in case "repair work may need to be carried out ..."

=> Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
In this case: Trong trường hợp này

Above all: Trên hết

By far: Cho đến nay

On the contrary: Ngược lại

=> A có nghĩa phù hợp nhất

cards.questionText:

childQuestions.transcript:
prominent: important or well known

thorough: done completely; with great attention to detail

casual: not formal

precise: clear and accurate

Based on the meaning of words.

=> Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
prominent: nổi bật

thorough: kỹ lưỡng

casual: bình thường

precise: chính xác

=> A có nghĩa phù hợp nhất

childQuestions.transcript:
generate: to produce energy, especially electricity

portray: to show somebody/something in a picture; to describe somebody/something in a piece of writing

house: to provide a place for a person or an animal to live

restore: to bring back a situation or feeling that existed before

Based on the meaning of words.

=> Choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
generate: tạo ra

portray: miêu tả

house: chứa

restore: khôi phục

=> C có nghĩa phù hợp nhất

options: (A) These unique artifacts had made the museum very popular.
(B) These include a lecture hall, gift shop, and cafe on the ground floor.
(C) The decision to renovate on the south wing was suspended.
(D) Museum visitors found the opening exhibit to be a complete success.
correctOptions: (B) These include a lecture hall, gift shop, and cafe on the ground floor.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on the previous sentence "In addition, it has facilities not found in the rest of the building."

=> Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Dựa vào câu trước chỗ trống "In addition, it has facilities not found in the rest of the building." (Ngoài ra, bảo tàng còn có những cơ sở vật chất không thể tìm thấy ở phần còn lại của tòa nhà.)

=> Chọn đáp án B

=> facilities (cơ sở vật chất) = a lecture hall, gift shop, and cafe on the ground floor (giảng đường, cửa hàng quà tặng và quán cà phê ở tầng trệt.)

Dấu hiệu "It will run ..."

=> Dùng thì tương lai đơn

=> Chọn đáp án D

childQuestions.transcript:
It describes an event that happens frequently => Use adverb "usually"

=> Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
usually: thường

safely: an toàn

deliberately: cố ý

accurately: chính xác

options: (A) You should consider placing a bulk order to get a free gift.

Based on the previous sentence

=> Choose D

Dựa vào câu trước chỗ trống "Our company usually offers them, but they are not applicable in all cases." (Công ty chúng tôi thường đưa ra mức giảm giá, nhưng  không áp dụng trong mọi trường hợp.)

childQuestions.transcript:
advantage: a thing that helps you to be better or more successful than other people

confirmation: a statement, letter, etc. that shows that something is true, correct or definite

reimbursement: the act of paying back money to somebody which they have spent or lost; the amount that is paid back

recommendation: an official suggestion about the best thing to do

Based on the meaning of words.

=> Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
advantage: lợi thế, lợi ích

confirmation: xác nhận

reimbursement: hoàn trả

recommendation: khuyến nghị

=> B có nghĩa phù hợp nhất

childQuestions.transcript:
envelope: a flat, usually square or rectangular, paper container for a letter

item: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc.
